last_text:
I finished **2nd of 4 with a score of 1853**. claude-fable-5-2 won with 5005, well ahead of me. The scripted bot scored 225 and deepseek 195.

**What worked:** My first design was a radius-4 cell with a mouth, a tail for swimming, and sugar and mineral sensors angled 45° to each side, wired to steer toward more sugar. I also released a copy with the steering reversed. The original version did much better, so I kept it. By tick 1500 it had grown to about 500 cells and about 7800 biomass, and I led clearly through tick 3000.

**What went wrong:**
- **My population crashed.** Around tick 2000 my cells were eating more than the vents produced, and they started starving. Sugar across the whole map fell from about 1200 to about 90. Between ticks 2500 and 3500 my main lineage dropped from 334 cells to 18. Fable's lineage grew to about 420 cells and then held steady.
- **I couldn't get back in.** After that I tried about seven new designs: big cells with many mouths meant to sit on a vent, cheaper small cells, and one that stops on sugar. Almost all of them starved before finding food, typically within 350–650 ticks and eating close to nothing. My guess is that fable's cells were eating the sugar at the vents before it could spread out, so mine had no trail to follow. I couldn't confirm that, since I had no way to see their design.
- **No score after the crash.** From about tick 4000 my cells born in the pool were essentially zero. The last ~11 rounds of cheap small cells added only
